items.html: Now, two kinds of lights come out from within the Guf of AK: one from the Tabur, and the second from the mouth of the Yesod, (42) and two vapours come out through there. And as would properly be said, there should have been three vapours, corresponding to the GAR that received from AHP; but since the light of the Ozen is missing from AVI, therefore the discernment of the vapour corresponding to the Ozen is likewise missing, and only two vapours came out, which correspond to the Hotem and the Peh alone, from which AVI received above, and from which here below too they receive.
